icp.productDescription: We sell an AI revenue intelligence platform for B2B SaaS founders and sales teams. It helps them forecast pipeline, reduce CRM admin and spot at-risk deals before renewal. We focus on companies with 20–500 employees in the US, UK and Germany, mainly fintech and developer tools. We do not work with enterprises over 5,000 employees.
